hooks.command: git -c alias.aif-hook=!sh aif-hook docs/ai-forward-pack/hooks/run-hook.sh dispatch.py --host grok --event PreToolUse
git -c alias.aif-hook=!sh aif-hook docs/ai-forward-pack/hooks/run-hook.sh dispatch.py --host grok --event UserPromptSubmit

git -c alias.aif-hook=!sh aif-hook -c 'r=.;n=0;while [ ! -f "$r/docs/ai-forward-pack/hooks/run-hook.sh" ];do [ -e "$r/.git" ] && exit 2;n=$((n+1));[ "$n" -le 64 ] || exit 2;r=$r/..;done;cd "$r" || exit 2;exec sh docs/ai-forward-pack/hooks/run-hook.sh "$@"' aif-hook dispatch.py --host grok --event SessionStart

git -c alias.aif-hook=!sh aif-hook -c 'r=.;n=0;while [ ! -f "$r/docs/ai-forward-pack/hooks/run-hook.sh" ];do [ -e "$r/.git" ] && exit 2;n=$((n+1));[ "$n" -le 64 ] || exit 2;r=$r/..;done;cd "$r" || exit 2;exec sh docs/ai-forward-pack/hooks/run-hook.sh "$@"' aif-hook dispatch.py --host grok --event SubagentStart
git -c alias.aif-hook=!sh aif-hook docs/ai-forward-pack/hooks/run-hook.sh dispatch.py --host grok --event Stop
